functionality.rationale: Every P1 native module will consume this graph; a wrong target, version, or build mode can break all runtime work.

security.rationale: OpenSSL and source provenance sit on the authenticated transport trust boundary; floating sources or system fallback are unacceptable.

performance.rationale: Static dependency builds affect clean-build time and packaged size, so content-addressed caches and bundle verification must remain effective.

compatibility.rationale: The pinned targets must remain consumable by existing native CMake, sanitizer, fuzz, and Flutter runner build shapes.

concurrency.rationale: This task installs and links dependencies but introduces no executor, socket, callback, or mutable runtime state.

platform.rationale: OpenSSL toolchains, static library formats, CRT selection, target architecture, and Flutter build entrypoints differ across all three desktop platforms.

persistence.rationale: Only reproducible build caches are persisted under ignored output directories; no product data or migration format changes.

adr.rationale: Complete discovery label validation requires selecting utf8proc 2.11.3 alongside the already accepted Asio/OpenSSL dependency profile.

architecture.rationale: The documented future vcpkg boundary becomes an implemented static dependency and build-entrypoint boundary.

roadmap.rationale: Dependency bootstrap unblocks P1 tasks but does not itself complete a user-visible roadmap milestone.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
